option_relations.rationale: The patient's presentation and laboratory results do not strongly suggest acute coronary syndrome as the primary diagnosis.
ST-segment elevation due to myocardial metastasis from squamous cell carcinoma of the lung could be a subtype of metastatic lung cancer to the heart.
Cardiac metastasis from lung cancer (intracardiac mass) is equivalent to metastatic lung cancer to the heart.
Metastatic cardiac tumor (secondary to lung cancer) is equivalent to metastatic lung cancer to the heart.
